title: Pasta Shapes
description: A collection of Italian pasta shapes with their literal meaning and typical use.

results.name: Spaghetti
results.typical_use: Tomato, oil, or seafood sauces such as marinara and aglio e olio.

results.name: Spaghettini
results.typical_use: Light, delicate sauces where thinner strands suit.

results.name: Linguine
results.typical_use: Seafood and pesto sauces; classic with clams (alle vongole).

results.name: Fettuccine
results.typical_use: Rich, creamy sauces such as Alfredo and meat ragu.

results.name: Tagliatelle
results.typical_use: Hearty meat sauces, most famously Bolognese.

results.name: Pappardelle
results.typical_use: Wide ribbons for rich game and braised meat ragus.

results.name: Bucatini
results.typical_use: Hollow strands ideal for amatriciana and cacio e pepe.

results.name: Vermicelli
results.typical_use: Light sauces and broths; thinner than spaghetti.

results.name: Capellini
results.typical_use: Very fine strands for delicate broths and light sauces.

results.name: Penne
results.typical_use: Chunky sauces and baked dishes; ridges hold sauce well.

results.name: Fusilli
results.typical_use: Pesto and creamy sauces; spirals trap sauce and pasta salads.

results.name: Farfalle
results.typical_use: Light cream or tomato sauces and cold pasta salads.

results.name: Orecchiette
results.typical_use: Classic with broccoli rabe and sausage in Puglia.

results.name: Rotini
results.typical_use: Corkscrew shape for pasta salads and thick sauces.

results.name: Gemelli
results.typical_use: Pesto, oil, and light tomato sauces; two twisted strands.

results.name: Cavatappi
results.typical_use: Baked dishes and cheese sauces; ridged spirals cling to sauce.

results.name: Radiatori
results.typical_use: Thick, creamy sauces caught in the ruffled ridges.

results.name: Rigatoni
results.typical_use: Hearty meat sauces and baked dishes; ridges hold sauce.

results.name: Macaroni
results.typical_use: Cheese sauces, most famously macaroni and cheese.

results.name: Ziti
results.typical_use: Baked casseroles such as baked ziti with tomato and cheese.

results.name: Cannelloni
results.typical_use: Stuffed with meat or ricotta, then baked in sauce.

results.name: Manicotti
results.typical_use: Large tubes filled with ricotta and baked.

results.name: Lasagne
results.typical_use: Layered and baked with ragu, bechamel, and cheese.

results.name: Ravioli
results.typical_use: Filled pillows of cheese, meat, or vegetables in sauce.

results.name: Tortellini
results.typical_use: Small rings filled with meat, served in broth or sauce.

results.name: Agnolotti
results.typical_use: Piedmontese filled pockets, often with roasted meat.

results.name: Tortelloni
results.typical_use: Larger stuffed pasta, typically ricotta and spinach.

results.name: Orzo
results.typical_use: Soups, salads, and pilaf-style dishes; resembles rice grains.

results.name: Ditalini
results.typical_use: Soups such as pasta e fagioli and minestrone.

results.name: Stelline
results.typical_use: Light soups and broths, popular in children's dishes.
